title: Terror Takes the Sound
about: A dorm-room scare that started a friendship and made a familiar Thriller lyric suddenly make sense.
description: This track tells a memory from Pirate Year, when I returned to State Arts-In as a performer. Before lights out one night, I quietly leaned beside Jason while he watched a video with headphones on and waited for him to turn around. When he finally did, he opened his mouth to scream but was too startled to make a sound. We immediately broke into laughter, and the moment became the beginning of a friendship. It also gave new meaning to a lyric from Thriller that I had performed many times: for the first time, I had actually watched terror take the sound.

Lyrics: Back again with songs to sing,
Never knew what this would bring.
Lights were low inside the hall,
I leaned beside him, didn't move,
Waiting just to see the truth.
We both fall to the floor.
Till we couldn't laugh no more.
I finally knew what Thriller meant...
Every night I'd heard that line,
Thought it only fit a show,
Then he turned and met my eyes,
Singing words I'd known for years.
Because I'd watched them happen here.
One lyric finally brought to life.
